import java.util.*;

public class Test {
    int rows, cols;
    Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
    long[][] binom = new long[64][64];
    long best = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    Map<Long, Long> memo = new HashMap<>();
    char[] seq;

    void dfs(long x, long y, int left, int right) {
        long d = Math.abs(x - y);
        if (best <= 1 || d - binom[left][rows] * binom[right][rows] >= best) return;
        if (left == 0 && right == 0) {
            if (d < best) best = d;
            return;
        }
        if (left > 0) {
            long c1 = binom[left][rows] - binom[left - 1][rows];
            long s2 = binom[right][rows];
            dfs(x, y + c1 * s2, left - 1, right);
        }
        if (right > 0) {
            long s1 = binom[left][rows];
            long c2 = binom[right][rows] - binom[right - 1][rows];
            dfs(x + s1 * c2, y, left, right - 1);
        }
    }

    long solve(long x, long y, int left, int right) {
        long key = x * 10000 + left * 100 + right;
        Long cached = memo.get(key);
        if (cached != null) return cached;
        long res = 0L;
        long d = Math.abs(x - y);
        if (d - binom[left][rows] * binom[right][rows] > best) {
            memo.put(key, res);
            return res;
        }
        if (left == 0 && right == 0) return 1;
        char ch = seq[left + right - 1];
        if (left > 0 && ch != 'B') {
            long c1 = binom[left][rows] - binom[left - 1][rows];
            long s2 = binom[right][rows];
            res += solve(x, y + c1 * s2, left - 1, right);
        }
        if (right > 0 && ch != 'A') {
            long s1 = binom[left][rows];
            long c2 = binom[right][rows] - binom[right - 1][rows];
            res += solve(x + s1 * c2, y, left, right - 1);
        }
        memo.put(key, res);
        return res;
    }

    void start() {
        rows = scanner.nextInt();
        cols = scanner.nextInt();
        scanner.nextLine();
        seq = scanner.nextLine().toCharArray();
        int limit = 2 * (rows + cols);
        for (int i = 0; i <= limit; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= limit; j++) {
                if (j == 0) binom[i][j] = 1;
                else if (i == 0) binom[i][j] = 0;
                else binom[i][j] = binom[i - 1][j - 1] + binom[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
        int v1 = rows + cols, v2 = rows + cols;
        long x = 0, y = 0;
        while (v1 >= rows && v2 >= rows) {
            if (x > y) {
                long c1 = binom[v1][rows] - binom[v1 - 1][rows];
                long s2 = binom[v2][rows];
                y += c1 * s2;
                v1--;
            } else {
                long s1 = binom[v1][rows];
                long c2 = binom[v2][rows] - binom[v2 - 1][rows];
                x += s1 * c2;
                v2--;
            }
        }
        best = Math.abs(x - y);
        dfs(0, 0, rows + cols, rows + cols);
        long ans = solve(0, 0, rows + cols, rows + cols);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Test().start();
    }
}

import java.util.*;

public class Test {
    static class Frame {
        long x, y;
        int v1, v2;
        int state;
        long sum;
        long result;
        boolean noCache;

        Frame(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.v1 = v1;
            this.v2 = v2;
            state = 0;
            sum = 0;
            result = 0;
            noCache = false;
        }
    }

    int r, c;
    Scanner sca = new Scanner(System.in);
    long[][] C = new long[64][64];
    long best = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    Map<Long, Long> cache = new HashMap<>();
    char[] cs;

    void dfs(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long d = Math.abs(x - y);
        if (best <= 1 || d - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] >= best) return;
        if (v1 == 0 && v2 == 0) {
            if (d < best) best = d;
            return;
        }
        if (v1 > 0) {
            long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r];
            long s2 = C[v2][r];
            dfs(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 > 0) {
            long s1 = C[v1][r];
            long c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            dfs(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
    }

    long solve(long x0, long y0, int v10, int v20) {
        Deque<Frame> stack = new ArrayDeque<>();
        stack.push(new Frame(x0, y0, v10, v20));
        long ans = 0L;

        while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
            Frame f = stack.peek();

            if (f.state == 0) {
                long key = f.x * 10000 + f.v1 * 100 + f.v2;
                Long cached = cache.get(key);
                if (cached != null) {
                    f.result = cached;
                    f.state = 3;
                    f.noCache = true;
                    continue;
                }

                long d = Math.abs(f.x - f.y);
                if (d - C[f.v1][r] * C[f.v2][r] > best) {
                    f.result = 0L;
                    f.state = 3;
                    continue;
                }

                if (f.v1 == 0 && f.v2 == 0) {
                    f.result = 1L;
                    f.state = 3;
                    f.noCache = true;
                    continue;
                }

                char ch = cs[f.v1 + f.v2 - 1];
                boolean canLeft = f.v1 > 0 && ch != 'B';
                boolean canRight = f.v2 > 0 && ch != 'A';

                if (!canLeft && !canRight) {
                    f.result = 0L;
                    f.state = 3;
                    continue;
                }

                f.sum = 0L;
                if (canLeft) {
                    f.state = 1;
                    long c1 = C[f.v1][r] - C[f.v1 - 1][r];
                    long s2 = C[f.v2][r];
                    stack.push(new Frame(f.x, f.y + c1 * s2, f.v1 - 1, f.v2));
                } else {
                    f.state = 2;
                    long s1 = C[f.v1][r];
                    long c2 = C[f.v2][r] - C[f.v2 - 1][r];
                    stack.push(new Frame(f.x + s1 * c2, f.y, f.v1, f.v2 - 1));
                }
            } else if (f.state == 3) {
                Frame finished = stack.pop();
                if (!finished.noCache) {
                    long key = finished.x * 10000 + finished.v1 * 100 + finished.v2;
                    cache.put(key, finished.result);
                }

                if (stack.isEmpty()) {
                    ans = finished.result;
                    continue;
                }

                Frame parent = stack.peek();
                parent.sum += finished.result;

                if (parent.state == 1) {
                    char ch = cs[parent.v1 + parent.v2 - 1];
                    boolean canRight = parent.v2 > 0 && ch != 'A';
                    if (canRight) {
                        parent.state = 2;
                        long s1 = C[parent.v1][r];
                        long c2 = C[parent.v2][r] - C[parent.v2 - 1][r];
                        stack.push(new Frame(parent.x + s1 * c2, parent.y, parent.v1, parent.v2 - 1));
                    } else {
                        parent.result = parent.sum;
                        parent.state = 3;
                    }
                } else if (parent.state == 2) {
                    parent.result = parent.sum;
                    parent.state = 3;
                }
            }
        }

        return ans;
    }

    void start() {
        r = sca.nextInt(); c = sca.nextInt(); sca.nextLine();
        cs = sca.nextLine().toCharArray();
        int n = 2 * (r + c);
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++)

                if (j == 0) C[i][j] = 1;
                else if (i == 0) C[i][j] = 0;
                else C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j];

        int v1 = r + c, v2 = r + c;
        long x = 0, y = 0;
        while (v1 >= r && v2 >= r) {
            if (x > y) {
                long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r];
                long s2 = C[v2][r];
                y += c1 * s2;
                v1--;
            } else {
                long s1 = C[v1][r];
                long c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
                x += s1 * c2;
                v2--;
            }
        }
        best = Math.abs(x - y);
        dfs(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
        long ans = solve(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
        System.out.println(ans);
